mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2.5% in a 3-month window, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for 3 months), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a weakening consumer demand, which triggers a negative outlook for corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% in the past month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a further decline in unemployment signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (INDPRO < 100 for 3 months), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline by more than 0.5% in the past quarter, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% year-over-year), a further rise in inflation signals central bank tightening and real interest rate increases, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 6.0% (y/y), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
